properties.site-address: Land at canalside, Oxford, OX2 6BX, (Jericho Canalside)
properties.notes: Planning permission 14/01441/FUL (now expired) was granted on 19/04/2016 for the demolition of various structures and the erection of 23 residential units together with new community centre, restaurant, boatyard, public square, winding hole and public bridge across the Oxford Canal. The site is in a sensitive location within the Jericho Conservation Area and adjacent to the Grade I listed St. Barnabas Church. The site is allocated in the emerging Local Plan 2036, which is currently undergoing an examination in public (consultation on proposed modifications following hearings).
properties.ownership-status: not owned by a public authority
